user.title: Emporia EV Charger
user.description: Choose how you sign in to Emporia. Use the same method you use in the Emporia app.

menu_option_descriptions.password: For an account created with an email address and a password.
menu_option_descriptions.apple: Opens Emporia's sign-in page in your browser.
menu_option_descriptions.google: Opens Emporia's sign-in page in your browser.

password.title: Emporia EV Charger
password.description:
Sign in with your Emporia app credentials.

Wrong method? If this account was created with Google or Apple, it has no password. Close this dialog and add the integration again to pick that method.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Emporia
reauth_confirm.description: Your Emporia session expired. Re-enter the password for {username}.

reauth_social.title: Re-authenticate Emporia
reauth_social.description: Your Emporia session expired. Continue to sign in with {provider} again.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid email or password. If this account was created with Google or Apple it has no password, so close this dialog and add the integration again to pick that method.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Emporia cloud. Try again.

abort.already_configured: This Emporia account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: That sign-in is for a different Emporia account than this entry.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Emporia cloud. Try again.
abort.sign_in_cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled, so nothing was set up. To try again, add the integration once more from Settings, then Devices and services.
abort.sign_in_rejected: The sign-in was refused before it completed ({error}), so nothing was set up. Add the integration again to retry, or pick a different sign-in method.
abort.no_refresh_token: Emporia completed the sign-in but returned nothing to stay signed in with. Start again from the integrations page.
abort.account_lookup_failed: The sign-in succeeded but Emporia would not return the account. Start again from the integrations page.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out preparing the Emporia sign-in link.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no URL to return to after sign-in. See {docs_url}.
abort.oauth_timeout: Timed out completing the Emporia sign-in.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: Emporia rejected the sign-in. It may have expired or already been used. Start again from the integrations page.
abort.oauth_failed: The Emporia sign-in did not complete. Start again from the integrations page.
abort.oauth_error: Emporia returned an unexpected sign-in response. Check the logs.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: The Emporia sign-in method is unavailable. Try again.
